context: Tests whether the agent follows the code-ticket workflow in the correct order: checking for tests before implementing, running the full suite post-implementation, using the prescribed scripts to open a PR, requesting Copilot review, waiting for the result, and only merging after a clean review.

checklist.name: Tests-first check command
checklist.description: The plan includes running `python3 scripts/run_tests.py --check` as the first step, before any implementation work

checklist.name: Gate on non-zero exit
checklist.description: The plan explicitly states that if `run_tests.py --check` exits non-zero, the agent stops and writes tests before proceeding — does NOT skip ahead to implementation

checklist.name: Full suite after implementation
checklist.description: After implementation, the plan runs `python3 scripts/run_tests.py` (without --check) to execute the full test suite

checklist.name: Iterate until suite passes
checklist.description: The plan describes fixing failures and re-running the suite until it exits 0, not stopping after a single run

checklist.name: PR opened via script
checklist.description: The plan opens the PR with `python3 scripts/open_pr.py --title "..." --body "..."`, not a manual git push or gh command

checklist.name: Copilot review requested
checklist.description: The plan calls `python3 scripts/request_copilot_review.py <pr-number>` after opening the PR

checklist.name: Await review via script
checklist.description: The plan calls `python3 scripts/await_copilot_review.py <pr-number>` to wait for the Copilot review result (not a polling loop or manual check)

checklist.name: Merge only after clean review
checklist.description: The plan explicitly conditions the merge step on the review JSON reporting `"clean": true`

checklist.name: Merge via script
checklist.description: The plan merges using `python3 scripts/merge_pr.py <pr-number>`, not a manual git merge or gh pr merge command

checklist.name: Fix-review loop described
checklist.description: The plan describes what to do if `clean` is false: fix every comment, push, re-request the review, and wait again

checklist.name: Correct step ordering
checklist.description: All steps appear in the correct order: check → implement → full-suite → open PR → request review → await review → (fix loop if needed) → merge
